I have farmed this land for many years, and maize needs some fertilizer to give a good harvest here in Oromia. I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative if it comes in time, though the price is high and my plot is small. I still use the seed I saved from last season — the local variety has always done well for me, and the improved seed costs too much. At my age I cannot do all the weeding and harvest alone, so my family will help, and I will pay a young man from the village for a few days of hard work.
